versions.content: Number of instances of a EcucContainerDef in the ECU Configuration Value description Each EcucContainerDef also has the features of EcucDefinitionElement which enables to specify for each EcucContain- erDef how often it is allowed to occur in the ECU Configuration Value description later on (see [TPS_ECUC_02008] for more details).
